(@ == "a")'::jsonpath) IS TRUE AS json_match FROM arrays

partial_coverage_counterexample.sql: WITH versions(id,version,hashes,indexed) AS (VALUES (1,1,ARRAY['a'],false),(1,2,ARRAY['b'],true)), candidates AS (SELECT id FROM versions WHERE indexed AND hashes @> ARRAY['a']), narrowed AS (SELECT * FROM versions WHERE NOT indexed OR id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)), winner AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(id) * FROM narrowed ORDER BY id,version DESC), canonical AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(id) * FROM versions ORDER BY id,version DESC) SELECT 'partial_index' AS method,count(*) FROM winner WHERE hashes @> ARRAY['a'] UNION ALL SELECT 'canonical',count(*) FROM canonical WHERE hashes @> ARRAY['a']
